# S2: all-category few-shot results

This study extends WCTE's inherited PatchCore implementation; the sprint contribution is the comparison harness, audit, expanded evaluation and analysis. DINOv2 scoring follows an established AnomalyDINO-style baseline, not a newly invented model.

Category-bootstrap uncertainty on this fixed benchmark; no factory/onboarding claim. V1 primary results were previously inspected.

Source: `S2_RESULTS/summary.json`; every configuration: `S2_RESULTS/per_seed.csv`.
